title: Personalized Metabolic Nutrition Sepsis Study
official: Personalized Metabolic Nutrition for Children With Sepsis
summary: Children with sepsis, a condition in which infection causes organ dysfunction will be enrolled with parental permission in this study. Nutrition will be given according to their individual metabolic profiles until normalization of metabolism. Metabolism is the way that children process food to meet our body's needs, based on metabolic testing the children may need more or less carbohydrates, more or less fats or more or less protein. The investigators will measure whether normalization of metabolism with this personalized nutrition leads to resolution of organ dysfunction.

interventions.name: For group Peds Sep A: Standard nutrition will be given
For Group Peds SepB: Low leucine, isoleucine formula
For Group Peds Sep C: Medium chain triglyceride oil enriched formula.
For Group Peds Sep D: Low carbohydrate ketogenic formula

criteria:
* Inclusion Criteria: Age 44 weeks gestation and greater than 30 days after birth and less than 18 years old
* Diagnosed with sepsis and organ failure

Exclusion Criteria: Lack of commitment to PICU care by limiting aggressive or life-prolonging treatments

* Limitation of life-sustaining treatments.
* Expectation of death in 48 hours as deemed by the clinical PICU attending.
